summary: C21 Investments Inc. filed a Form 6-K announcing a definitive arrangement agreement under which Vireo Growth Inc. will acquire all C21 shares (after conversion of subordinate voting shares) in a stock-for-stock transaction. Each C21 shareholder will receive 0.023052 Vireo subordinate voting shares per C21 share (Exchange Ratio). The C21 Board formed a Special Committee that, with independent financial and legal advisors, unanimously recommended the transaction. C21 operates three Nevada dispensaries and ~104,000 sq ft of cultivation/production capacity. Post-acquisition, Vireo expects ~15 dispensaries and 158,000 sq ft in Nevada. The transaction is subject to shareholder, court, and regulatory approvals; watch for voting outcome and close timeline.
